Champion rankings

Champion tier list

Tier rankings are calculated from your synced match history, with small samples smoothed toward 50%.

S → F · HISTORICAL
Sync match data to calculate champion tiers.
How S–F tiers are assigned
S80–100 pointsA68–79 pointsB56–67 pointsC44–55 pointsD32–43 pointsF0–31 points
Score = 30% adjusted win rate + 20% KDA + 15% CS/min + 10% vision/min + 15% objectives + 10% champion damage/min. The win rate is smoothed toward 50% using a five-game prior. Each champion is ranked against other champions in the selected player and role data. Filters change the comparison group, so tiers can change. Each metric is converted to a relative percentile before weighting. With All Players and All Roles, score equals the raw win-rate percentage and tiers use the configured thresholds. With filters, the weighted percentile score applies. Results reflect tracked matches, not global rankings.
Sync your matches to build the tier list.

Tier score combines smoothed win rate (30%), KDA (20%), CS/min (15%), vision score/min (10%), objective takedowns/game (15%) and champion damage/min (10%). Each metric is ranked relative to the champions in the current selection; small win-rate samples are smoothed toward 50%. Portraits show actual win rate, game count and composite score. This describes your retrieved match sample, not the current global meta.

Rune intelligence

Rune tier list

Explore S–F rune tiers for your group, individual players, roles, and champions. Click a rune for its detailed report.

MATCH HISTORY · ITEMS
⌕
Load cached or live match data to see rune rankings.
How S–F tiers are assigned
S80–100 pointsA68–79 pointsB56–67 pointsC44–55 pointsD32–43 pointsF0–31 points
Score = 85% adjusted win-rate rank + 15% sample-size rank. The win rate is smoothed toward 50% using a five-game prior. Each rune is scored against other runes in the currently selected matches. Filters change the comparison group, so tiers can change. Scores show historical association, not proof of effectiveness.
No match data loaded.

Runes are read from Riot match perk selections (keystones and minor runes; stat shards excluded). Scores compare each rune against other runes in your selected dataset. Rune win rates are correlations, not evidence that a rune caused the win.

MATCH HISTORY · ITEMS
⌕
⌕
Load cached or live match data to see item rankings.
How S–F tiers are assigned
S80–100 pointsA68–79 pointsB56–67 pointsC44–55 pointsD32–43 pointsF0–31 points
Score = 85% adjusted win-rate rank + 15% sample-size rank. The win rate is smoothed toward 50% using a five-game prior. Each item is scored against other items in the currently selected matches. Filters change the comparison group, so tiers can change. Scores show historical association, not proof of effectiveness.
No match data loaded.

Items are counted once per tracked player's final inventory per match (slots 0–5). Win rates are smoothed toward 50% with a five-game prior, and scores are relative to the selected sample. Items are correlated with wins, not necessarily their cause: expensive items are more likely to be completed in games already being won. This does not represent purchase order, builds, or the global meta.

Enemy draft counter-lab

Build a draft into their matchup

Enter the enemy champion in each role. Riftmates will generate several different five-player lineups, matching your player and champion to each lane matchup.

MULTIPLE SUGGESTIONS
Sync your squad to build matchup suggestions.
Enter the enemy team's champions, then generate up to three unique draft suggestions.
ⓘ
How matchup suggestions work: role and champion comfort are scored from your synced history. If tracked matches contain the opposing laner, their champion matchup results are included; otherwise matchup evidence is marked unavailable and the suggestion relies on player/role/champion fit. This is a recommendation heuristic, not a guaranteed counter or win prediction.

How the ratings work

Each slot gets a 0–100 estimate, with confidence shown based on sample size.

ⓘ
Scoring model: 40% player role-fit (role win rate smoothed toward overall win rate), 35% champion comfort (the player's results on that champion), and 25% role-specific champion results. Missing evidence falls back toward a neutral score rather than pretending to know. Small samples are smoothed and flagged as low confidence. It does not model team composition, counters, patch strength, enemy draft, or champion mechanics.

SQUAD RESET

Professional team import

Choose one professional team. Importing it replaces the active squad accounts with the accounts discovered for that team, so all analytics focus on that team.

DPM.LOL

Import replaces the current account list (you can restore or edit accounts in Your Squad). Accounts are discovered from public DPM.LOL and RIFTVANTA player profiles; coverage depends on publicly listed accounts. Queue filters and Riot API access still apply.

RIFTMATES · STAT CONFIGURATION

Analytics thresholds & display limits

Configure League and TFT scoring, minimum samples, display limits and per-role performance weights. Values are loaded from a persistent JSON file on the server.

JSON SETTINGS

Loading stat settings…

Profile & post-match labels

Every label can be renamed, enabled/disabled and assigned a minimum sample size. Select a role to override a label for Top, Jungle, Mid, ADC or Support. A minimum-game setting only applies to multi-game profile labels; single-match awards still evaluate their match. Numeric trigger parameters are applied to each label’s statistical condition. The field shows the original expression and default. Leave role-specific triggers blank to inherit Global.
